one_line: agents pay per artefact — issuance, assembly, cadence; the board and verification stay free
mode_note: A settled receipt (facilitator /verify then /settle) unlocks the paid artefact. Verification of every artefact stays free.

offer-receipt.offers: signed only when BOARD_SIGN_KEY_PKCS8_B64 is provisioned and an accepts[] entry can be committed; otherwise the 402 omits the offer-receipt block and csoai.offer_receipt names the gap
offer-receipt.receipts: signed only after facilitator-confirmed settlement when the facilitator names a payer and BOARD_SIGN_KEY_PKCS8_B64 is provisioned; otherwise receiptGap names why no signed receipt was attached
offer-receipt.eip712: NOT offered. The extension admits eip712 and jws; when a board key is provisioned the edge can emit jws but has no secp256k1 signer. A client that requires eip712 should treat this rail as unsigned rather than expect a format we cannot produce.

verify.offline: https://councilof.ai/verifier/verify_receipt.py — same-site checker; reads the public DID document or replays a retained local copy; guide https://councilof.ai/verifier/receipt-toolkit.md

resources.description: Live board totals and the signed public root, free: the axis totals and Merkle root, served through a real x402 settle. Verification is free forever; the same bytes answer 200 at /api/gspc and /root.json.

resources.note: Payable and priced at zero — it settles, and charges nothing. It answers 402 rather than 200 on purpose: the x402 Bazaar catalogues only a resource that settles, so a 200 route cannot be indexed. It belongs in resources rather than quarantined because it is a live 402 route, not a withdrawn one. To read the same content without any x402 handshake, GET a free_equivalents URL — those answer 200.
